rundown: Gold beat Cruise 112-100 at Wayne State Fieldhouse in Detroit, MI in front of 1,962. Gold led 57-48 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Gold won it 35-17.
Leading the way — Gold: Cam Whitmore 32 pts; Ryan Nembhard 14 ast; DaRon Holmes II 10 reb. Cruise: John Ukomadu 24 pts, 11 reb; Bryson Warren 8 ast.
Where Gold won it: they shot 50% to 42%, shot 44% from three to 31% and had 31 assists to 23.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 17, 10:58 AM ET. It had Gold 30% and Cruise 70%, projecting Gold 110 – Cruise 116.1 (226.1 total, Cruise by 6.1).

Final: Gold 112 – Cruise 100. Wrong winner: it had Cruise at 70%, and Gold (30%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Gold came in with a 9% above average attack and a 11% leakier than average defense (1-3, 112.8 scored and 116.8 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 110, they scored 112 (+2 points, 2% over); projected to allow 116.1, they allowed 100 (−16.1 points, 14% under).

Cruise came in with a 13% above average attack and a 11% leakier than average defense (2-1, 129 scored and 124 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 11 and 10 games of evidence. Projected to score 116.1, they scored 100 (−16.1 points, 14% under); projected to allow 110, they allowed 112 (+2 points, 2% over).

The bigger miss was Cruise's scoring (-16.1 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 212 against 226.1 projected (-14.1), about the 19th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Gold by 12 against Cruise by 6.1 projected, about the 7th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.949 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -19.2 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 69 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.012 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Gold attack ×0.993, defense ×0.983 (5 games); Cruise attack ×1.009, defense ×1.016 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 18.1 points), no bet.
